Documentation / Developer / Technical Notes

Technical Notes

Technical notes are focused maintainer contracts below the project-wide owners listed in the Developer Documentation index. An active note owns only its named implementation area; it does not replace architecture, repository, build, or subsystem policy.

MVR contracts

  • Canonical MVR contract — canonical MVR format and behavior rules for Perastage.
  • MVR exporter diagnostics
  • MVR-xchange TCP Mode publisher
  • Canonical hoist metadata
  • Truss geometry authority
  • Truss metadata and resources

The focused MVR identity recovery, truss attachment candidates, and fixture attachment paths contracts live one level above because they span MVR and scene-model ownership.

GDTF contracts

  • GDTF Unicode ZIP filename compatibility
  • GDTF editor architecture
  • GDTF editor UI layout
  • GDTF read/write compatibility
  • GDTF mode and channel browser
  • GDTF wheel and attribute inspector

These notes defer mutation and derivative identity rules to the canonical GDTF Mutation Policy and GDTF resource identity documents.

Viewer and rendering contracts

  • Viewer2D rendering and capture
  • Viewer2D state ownership
  • Print Viewer2D options
  • OpenGL lifecycle
  • Scene-model symbol capture
  • Basic geometry primitives
  • Viewer3D performance stress scenario

Runtime and storage contracts

  • Runtime storage and temporary workspaces
